What comes up in Brookvale

3 conditions, and each one is handled differently

Every site is scoped on the day. The table is what the work usually involves here rather than a statement about any particular property.

Industrial strip out and structure

Brookvale work is warehouse and factory rather than residential, and there is usually a slab and a hardstand underneath it.

How it is handled
Soft strip, then the structure in a planned sequence, with steel and clean concrete separated as it comes down and crushed for reuse.
What does it
Large excavator with a shear or grapple, hydraulic hammer, truck and dogs for volume.

Keeping the neighbouring units trading

Industrial estates here are occupied, so the surrounding businesses keep operating right through the job.

How it is handled
Hoarding, dust and noise control, agreed hours and a sequence that keeps the neighbouring access and loading open throughout.
What does it
Machines sized to the hoarded area, with water on hand for dust.

Internal strip outs and partial removal

Walls, floors, linings and fit out taken out of a building that stays standing, usually ahead of a renovation rather than a rebuild.

How it is handled
Hazardous materials cleared first, then the removal done by hand so that what remains is not disturbed. Structural elements are identified before anything is cut.
What does it
Hand tools and small plant only, with material carried out and loaded at the kerb.

Brookvale

What shapes the work on these blocks

  • The industrial heart of the peninsula Warehouse, factory and commercial work rather than knockdowns.
  • Better truck access Industrial streets built for heavy vehicles, which helps the cartage considerably.
  • Operating neighbours Tenancies that keep trading through a demolition, so hoarding, dust control and hours are planned around them.
  • Steel and concrete recycling Separated as it comes down rather than mixed.

Brookvale is the one part of the Northern Beaches where the trucks are not the problem. The industrial streets will take a truck and dog, and there is usually room to stand and load properly. The planning effort goes into working alongside the businesses that stay open.

Brookvale questions

What people ask before we start

Can you demolish a warehouse while the units next door keep trading?
Yes, and it is common here. It means hoarding, dust and noise control, agreed hours and a sequence that keeps access open for the neighbours. It is slower than an empty site and it is quoted that way.
What happens to the steel?
It is separated and recycled. On an industrial demolition the recoverable steel and clean concrete are a real part of the economics, not a formality.
What happens if a truck and dog cannot get into the street?
The same volume goes out in bogie or 10 wheeler tippers, which is more loads and a longer programme. It is worked out before the quote rather than discovered on day one, because on this peninsula it is frequently the single biggest variable.
Is the asbestos removal a separate engagement?
A separate licence, but not a separate engagement. Licensed asbestos removalists carry out the removal and an independent licensed assessor issues the clearance, while Max holds demolition licence AD214737 and runs the programme across all of it.
